title: Damped Double Pendulum
description: Two-link planar double pendulum with positive-definite principal inertia tensors, revolute joints from the inertial frame, and rotational spring-damper stabilization.
code:
<simpack_model name="DampedDoublePendulum">
  <!-- Upper and lower pendulum links with valid positive-definite inertia tensors -->
  <body id="link_upper" name="UpperLink" mass="3.2" ixx="0.065" iyy="0.065" izz="0.025" />
  <body id="link_lower" name="LowerLink" mass="2.1" ixx="0.042" iyy="0.042" izz="0.018" />

  <!-- Markers -->
  <marker id="m_ground_pivot" body="$inertial" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_upper_top" body="link_upper" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="0.25" />
  <marker id="m_upper_tip" body="link_upper" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="-0.25" />
  <marker id="m_lower_top" body="link_lower" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="0.20" />

  <!-- Kinematic Revolute Joints (2 bodies = 12 DOF, 2 revolute = 10 constraints => 2 DOF) -->
  <joint id="j_shoulder" type="revolute" from="m_ground_pivot" to="m_upper_top" />
  <joint id="j_elbow" type="revolute" from="m_upper_tip" to="m_lower_top" />

  <!-- Viscous joint damping -->
  <spring id="d_shoulder" from="m_ground_pivot" to="m_upper_top" kx="0" ky="0" kz="0" cx="0" cy="0.35" cz="0" />
  <spring id="d_elbow" from="m_upper_tip" to="m_lower_top" kx="0" ky="0" kz="0" cx="0" cy="0.20" cz="0" />
</simpack_model>

title: Helical Spring-Damper Isolation Mount
description: Industrial compressor skid supported on four tri-axial helical spring-damper isolation mounts with realistic 3D principal inertias and stiffness-damping elements.
code:
<simpack_model name="HelicalIsolationMount">
  <!-- 6-DOF Compressor Skid Body -->
  <body id="compressor_skid" name="CompressorSkid" mass="480.0" ixx="62.0" iyy="115.0" izz="140.0" />

  <!-- Ground anchor markers at four corners -->
  <marker id="m_gnd_fl" body="$inertial" x="0.65" y="0.45" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_gnd_fr" body="$inertial" x="0.65" y="-0.45" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_gnd_rl" body="$inertial" x="-0.65" y="0.45" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_gnd_rr" body="$inertial" x="-0.65" y="-0.45" z="0.0" />

  <!-- Skid corner mount markers -->
  <marker id="m_skid_fl" body="compressor_skid" x="0.65" y="0.45" z="-0.18" />
  <marker id="m_skid_fr" body="compressor_skid" x="0.65" y="-0.45" z="-0.18" />
  <marker id="m_skid_rl" body="compressor_skid" x="-0.65" y="0.45" z="-0.18" />
  <marker id="m_skid_rr" body="compressor_skid" x="-0.65" y="-0.45" z="-0.18" />

  <!-- Four Tri-Axial Helical Isolation Mounts -->
  <spring id="mount_fl" from="m_gnd_fl" to="m_skid_fl" kx="18000" ky="18000" kz="48000" cx="450" cy="450" cz="1400" />
  <spring id="mount_fr" from="m_gnd_fr" to="m_skid_fr" kx="18000" ky="18000" kz="48000" cx="450" cy="450" cz="1400" />
  <spring id="mount_rl" from="m_gnd_rl" to="m_skid_rl" kx="18000" ky="18000" kz="48000" cx="450" cy="450" cz="1400" />
  <spring id="mount_rr" from="m_gnd_rr" to="m_skid_rr" kx="18000" ky="18000" kz="48000" cx="450" cy="450" cz="1400" />
</simpack_model>

title: Automotive MacPherson Strut Suspension
description: Front-corner MacPherson strut automotive suspension combining a sprung quarter-chassis, lower control arm, knuckle-strut assembly, rotating wheel-tire body, and compliant coilover spring-damper.
code:
<simpack_model name="MacPhersonStrutSuspension">
  <!-- Bodies with valid positive-definite principal inertias -->
  <body id="chassis" name="QuarterChassis" mass="360.0" ixx="85.0" iyy="130.0" izz="150.0" />
  <body id="lca" name="LowerControlArm" mass="4.5" ixx="0.06" iyy="0.08" izz="0.07" />
  <body id="knuckle" name="SteeringKnuckle" mass="11.2" ixx="0.16" iyy="0.18" izz="0.14" />
  <body id="wheel" name="WheelTire" mass="21.5" ixx="1.10" iyy="1.80" izz="1.10" />

  <!-- Markers -->
  <marker id="m_road" body="$inertial" x="0.0" y="0.76" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_chassis_lca" body="chassis" x="0.0" y="0.28" z="0.24" />
  <marker id="m_chassis_tower" body="chassis" x="0.0" y="0.56" z="0.78" />
  <marker id="m_lca_inboard" body="lca" x="0.0" y="-0.20" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_lca_balljoint" body="lca" x="0.0" y="0.20" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_knuckle_lower" body="knuckle" x="0.0" y="-0.04" z="-0.12" />
  <marker id="m_knuckle_strut" body="knuckle" x="0.0" y="-0.06" z="0.22" />
  <marker id="m_knuckle_spindle" body="knuckle" x="0.0" y="0.08" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_wheel_hub" body="wheel" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_wheel_patch" body="wheel" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="-0.32" />

  <!-- Joints: 4 bodies (24 DOF); 2 revolute (10) + 1 spherical (3) = 13 constraints => 11 DOF -->
  <joint id="j_lca_pivot" type="revolute" from="m_chassis_lca" to="m_lca_inboard" />
  <joint id="j_lower_ball" type="spherical" from="m_lca_balljoint" to="m_knuckle_lower" />
  <joint id="j_wheel_spin" type="revolute" from="m_knuckle_spindle" to="m_wheel_hub" />

  <!-- MacPherson Strut Coilover & Vertical Tire Stiffness -->
  <spring id="strut_coilover" from="m_chassis_tower" to="m_knuckle_strut" kx="8500" ky="8500" kz="36000" cx="350" cy="350" cz="2900" />
  <spring id="tire_vertical" from="m_road" to="m_wheel_patch" kx="120000" ky="110000" kz="220000" cx="150" cy="150" cz="250" />
</simpack_model>

  <marker id="m_carrier_pin2" body="carrier" x="0.0" y="-0.26" z="0.4503" />
  <marker id="m_carrier_pin3" body="carrier" x="0.0" y="-0.26" z="-0.4503" />
  <marker id="m_sun_axis" body="sun_gear" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="0.0" />

  <!-- Elastomeric Torque-Arm Mounts & Gear Mesh Stiffness -->

title: High-Speed Passenger Rail Bogie Assembly
description: Multi-file high-speed rail bogie model comprising a sprung bogie frame, leading and trailing wheelsets, primary axlebox suspensions, yaw dampers, and companion wheelset and UIC60 rail substructure definitions.
code:
<simpack_model name="HighSpeedRailBogie">
  <!-- Carbody half-mass, Bogie Frame, and Leading/Trailing Wheelsets -->
  <body id="carbody" name="CarbodyHalf" mass="16500.0" ixx="32000.0" iyy="850000.0" izz="860000.0" />
  <body id="bogie_frame" name="BogieFrame" mass="2650.0" ixx="1850.0" iyy="1620.0" izz="3100.0" />
  <body id="ws_front" name="LeadingWheelset" mass="1480.0" ixx="820.0" iyy="140.0" izz="820.0" />
  <body id="ws_rear" name="TrailingWheelset" mass="1480.0" ixx="820.0" iyy="140.0" izz="820.0" />

  <!-- Track reference markers -->
  <marker id="m_track_front" body="$inertial" x="1.25" y="0.0" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_track_rear" body="$inertial" x="-1.25" y="0.0" z="0.0" />

  <!-- Carbody & Bogie Secondary Suspension Markers -->
  <marker id="m_cb_sec_l" body="carbody" x="0.0" y="1.0" z="-0.85" />
  <marker id="m_cb_sec_r" body="carbody" x="0.0" y="-1.0" z="-0.85" />
  <marker id="m_bf_sec_l" body="bogie_frame" x="0.0" y="1.0" z="0.25" />
  <marker id="m_bf_sec_r" body="bogie_frame" x="0.0" y="-1.0" z="0.25" />

  <!-- Bogie Primary Axlebox Suspension Markers -->
  <marker id="m_bf_fl" body="bogie_frame" x="1.25" y="1.0" z="-0.15" />
  <marker id="m_bf_fr" body="bogie_frame" x="1.25" y="-1.0" z="-0.15" />
  <marker id="m_bf_rl" body="bogie_frame" x="-1.25" y="1.0" z="-0.15" />
  <marker id="m_bf_rr" body="bogie_frame" x="-1.25" y="-1.0" z="-0.15" />

  <!-- Wheelset Markers -->
  <marker id="m_wsf_l" body="ws_front" x="0.0" y="1.0" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_wsf_r" body="ws_front" x="0.0" y="-1.0" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_wsf_cp" body="ws_front" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="-0.46" />
  <marker id="m_wsr_l" body="ws_rear" x="0.0" y="1.0" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_wsr_r" body="ws_rear" x="0.0" y="-1.0" z="0.0" />
  <marker id="m_wsr_cp" body="ws_rear" x="0.0" y="0.0" z="-0.46" />

  <!-- Secondary Air Springs & Yaw Damping -->
  <spring id="sec_air_l" from="m_bf_sec_l" to="m_cb_sec_l" kx="160000" ky="160000" kz="420000" cx="25000" cy="35000" cz="40000" />
  <spring id="sec_air_r" from="m_bf_sec_r" to="m_cb_sec_r" kx="160000" ky="160000" kz="420000" cx="25000" cy="35000" cz="40000" />

  <!-- Primary Axlebox Coil Springs -->
  <spring id="prim_fl" from="m_wsf_l" to="m_bf_fl" kx="9.5e6" ky="4.2e6" kz="1.15e6" cx="12000" cy="10000" cz="18000" />
  <spring id="prim_fr" from="m_wsf_r" to="m_bf_fr" kx="9.5e6" ky="4.2e6" kz="1.15e6" cx="12000" cy="10000" cz="18000" />
  <spring id="prim_rl" from="m_wsr_l" to="m_bf_rl" kx="9.5e6" ky="4.2e6" kz="1.15e6" cx="12000" cy="10000" cz="18000" />
  <spring id="prim_rr" from="m_wsr_r" to="m_bf_rr" kx="9.5e6" ky="4.2e6" kz="1.15e6" cx="12000" cy="10000" cz="18000" />

  <!-- Track Elastic Foundation Support -->
  <spring id="track_front" from="m_track_front" to="m_wsf_cp" kx="1.0e5" ky="1.8e7" kz="8.5e7" cx="2000" cy="35000" cz="65000" />
